name: PLATO Continuous Non-Convex QPLIB Benchmark
description: Benchmarks global optimisation solvers on 102 continuous non-convex QP instances from QPLIB, where all variables are continuous but the objective or constraints are non-convex quadratic, requiring proof of global optimality. Only instances solved by at least one solver are reported. Tests solvers' ability to find and certify global optima in non-convex continuous spaces via spatial branch-and-bound.
domain: optimization, nonlinear programming, global optimization, operations research
typical_sota_score: BARON (1.0 scaled mean, 31 solved); ANTIGONE (1.64x, 35 solved). 3-hour time limit, 8 threads.
reputation: Specialist global NLP benchmark; maintained by Hans Mittelmann at ASU.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Hardware: Intel Xeon Gold 6230 (40 cores, 385GB RAM). ANTIGONE solves more instances than BARON but is slower per instance. Problems from QPLIB (qplib.zib.de).
